title: My Air
text:
Do you like Air Bank? You can go out with her. With our mobile banking application, you can like us wherever you are. And what does it do? It shows you anytime how much money you have in your account. You can comfortably submit a specific payment by simply scanning a QR code. You have a perfect overview of all your payments. Moreover, there are extra handy filters. You can also sort your individual payments into groups so you know how much you spend. You would like to withdraw money and do not carry the card? In a few seconds it will create a code for you with which you can withdraw money without your card at more than 4,300 Sazka terminals. When you point your camera at the street, you immediately see the nearest ATM, our branch or Sazka terminal. It helps you block your card or change its limits within a few moments. It constantly carries current exchange rates with it and entertains you with our news. Your best choice is to get to know the application by yourself. Tip: You can set additional security measures, for instance confirmation of your payments by a signature password. You can create this password simply in your internet banking and change it anytime in the same place. For each mobile phone in which you have the application, you can specify in your internet banking whether you will carry out active operations through it, such as payment orders. If you lose your cell phone, remember that you can easily block it in your internet banking. Once you do, nobody can access your accounts from it.

title: VeloBank
text:
We present a new version of mobile banking. See what it looks like now: 1. Desktop - a modern command center where you immediately see what is most important to you. Customize your quick shortcuts, choose your favorite product and we will display it first. 2. Do you need to check the details of your accounts, deposits, loans or credit cards? You have everything at hand in the Finance tab. 3. Do you want to order your payments quickly and conveniently? Use BLIK phone transfers, save regular recipients and transfers. You can add repetitive operations to quick shortcuts. More in the Payments tab. 4. Do you need to quickly convert funds at a favorable rate? You can do it free of charge, 24 hours a day at our currency exchange office. Activate mobile payments and pay conveniently with your phone as with a contactless card. Do you want to quickly and conveniently pay for tickets or parking in our application? You will find all this in the Services tab. 5. Do you need a loan or credit card? Do you want to open an account or deposit? Check our offer in the Offers tab. You can submit product or service requests here. You can check the list of submitted applications at any time. title: YouBusiness App
text:
Welcome to YouBusiness App, the app at your side for managing your business needs! You will be able to have everything you need for your business at hand, directly on your smartphone or tablet. YouBusiness App offers you many different services, fundamental for your business, in a single app, including: 1 - CONSULT COMPANY BALANCE AND MOVEMENTS In our home page, you will immediately find the balance and movements of your accounts so as to monitor company accounting and better manage expenses. Furthermore, thanks to CBI (Interbank Corporate Banking), you can operate on the accounts you have at other banks directly through the app. 2 - MAKE BANK TRANSFERS With YouBusiness App, you can make transfers quickly and easily. You can choose between ordinary, urgent or instant bank transfer. And if you want to inform the beneficiary immediately, use the "Share" function to send the details instantly. 3 - PAY WITH THE CAMERA MAV and RAV, CBILL and PagoPA Forget the boredom of manually filling out postal slips, CBILL and PagoPA, MAV and RAV. With our app, you can pay conveniently by scanning the QR Codes with your smartphone camera and following the simple instructions. 4 - AUTHORIZE BILLS AND PAY RI.BA. The Bills section allows you to authorize, even in multiple modes, provisions already compiled on YouBusiness Web. Furthermore, the Archive allows you to quickly access the bills already authorized for quick consultation. title: UniCredit mBanking Business
text:
After signing the contract in the bank branch office, you can activate the mBanking service of the UniCredit mBanking Business small business mobile application with digital userID or in case you have already access to SpectraNet service, use the connected user ID and password. You can log in to the service and authenticate transactions faster with biometric identification on devices capable of reading fingerprints and face recognition. The functions of UniCredit mBanking Business: • Functions based on authorization levels • Later and multiple signature option • Payment to new beneficiary or using a template • Request to pay creation, reception and management (with push messages) • Qvik instant payment solutions (QR-code, NFC and deeplink) • Transfer between own accounts, even with currency conversion • Checking the status of account balances and savings • Register, modify and delete secondary IDs • Activation of debit card • Temporary suspension and unsuspension of debit card • Debit Card limit modification • View PIN of bank cards • Card registration to Google Pay • Managing standing orders (new and existing) • Creating, deleting, editing direct debit forms • Login and transaction-signing with fingerprint • SEPA transactions • Scan & Pay • Term Deposit • Monthly eStatements • Push notifications about outgoing and incoming transactions Other functions: Exchange rates
